name: Tonga Runetotem
summary: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem watches the Barrens' oases grow sick. Sent from Thunder Bluff, the tauren druid studies a corruption harming the region's wildlife and seeks its source before the fragile ecosystem fails.

sections.title: Watcher at the Crossroads
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem studies the Barrens' changing land. His elders in Thunder Bluff sent him from Mulgore, and he knows the dry savannah well. Where travelers see scrub and predators, Tonga watches for signs of the land's health. Lately, those signs have turned troubling. He seeks travelers who can help him investigate the scattered oases, the heart of life across the savannah.

sections.title: Tainted Waters and Warped Beasts
sections.body: Water is scarce in the Barrens, and the Forgotten Pools and Stagnant Oasis have turned volatile. Strange magical vapors bubble up, and creatures that drink from the waters are changing into aggressive, unnatural forms. Tonga gathers plant and creature samples to learn whether the sickness comes from natural decay or an outside power. His findings point toward deep fissures beneath the ground, linking the poisoned pools to the passages of the Wailing Caverns.

sections.title: The Runetotem Lineage
sections.body: Tonga bears the Runetotem clan name and the druidic heritage championed by Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. Hamuul keeps ties with the Cenarion Circle and studies in Moonglade's sacred groves, while scouts like Tonga serve on the frontier. Tonga draws on Moonglade's botanical wisdom to prepare healing salves and counter poisons. His work puts the young tauren druidic tradition to use within the fledgling Horde.

faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem is a tauren druid near the inn at the Crossroads in the Barrens. His elders in Thunder Bluff sent him to investigate strange corruption spreading across the savannah.

faq.q: What is Tonga investigating in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Tonga investigates strange vapors, mutated beasts, and tainted waters in the Barrens' oases, including the Forgotten Pools and the Stagnant Oasis.

faq.q: Where does Tonga believe the corruption is coming from?
faq.answer: Tonga's study of altered creatures and water fissures leads him to believe the magical taint comes from deep underground in the Wailing Caverns.

faq.q: Is Tonga related to Hamuul Runetotem?
faq.answer: Tonga and Hamuul Runetotem share the Runetotem name, but whether they are related is unknown. Tonga sends word of the Barrens' troubles to Archdruid Hamuul, the elder druid on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise.

faq.q: What does Tonga do for the poisoned wildlife?
faq.answer: Tonga uses teachings from Moonglade and local reagents to prepare salves for poisoned gazelles and counter toxins from sources such as Dreadmist Peak.

faq.q: Why is Tonga stationed at the Crossroads instead of Camp Taurajo or Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The Crossroads sits at the northern Barrens' central hub, close to the affected oases. From there, Tonga can reach travelers able to venture into dangerous country for him.

angles.text: As a tauren druid learning your craft, you can see how Cenarion teachings help diagnose and cleanse blighted lands far from Moonglade.
As a tauren, you share Tonga's duty to the Earth Mother as he works to protect the scarce waters that sustain life across the dry plains.
As a member of the Horde, you depend on Tonga's study to help keep the Barrens' main road habitable and safe from magical threats below ground.
